about: Where the screen design lcd32dsq_fx2_v1 may have a site, and where only a guard (FX2 1.01 cpapp-b.bin addresses; build/build_lcd_fx2.py, modding/FX2_PORT_SCREEN.md). Read by gen_fx2_write.py.

lcd32dsq_fx2_v1.sites_note: fit-mode words of the VDF fit function 0x1f9e98; the de-squeeze calculator 0x1fa0c0's ratio words; the two code tests of the 2.0x crop in 0x721e3c; the two code tests of the output rectangle in 0x7214b6; the three frame tables (cpActAfWindow, cpActTrackingFrame, the third widget)
lcd32dsq_fx2_v1.guards_note: a guard may also lie in the fit function and its tables, the de-squeeze calculator, the crop function or the output-rectangle function
